# DECISIONS_T2 — Track 2 (PROTEUS) rows from T2-D99 on (pre-registered before the numbers exist; LESSONS F1)

> **Public copy.** Personal names, account names, other teams' names and submission ids, the names of unrelated projects, the cluster allocation's id and file-system roots were replaced by neutral placeholders such as `[a team]`, "the in-house FM project" and `$S1_ROOT`, also inside text marked verbatim. Passages that are not about model development (upload logistics) and private detail of an in-house dataset and of an in-house model that is still in development were cut and are marked `[…]`; a row that was only about such a topic keeps its id and date and a one-line note. A few remarks about other entries were reworded neutrally. Nothing else was edited.

T2 rows D81–D97 live in `docs/DECISIONS.md` (one D sequence shared with T1 until 2026-10-14). From T2-D99 on, T2 writes
here, so the T1 / T2 numbering can no longer collide (a T2 "D92" became D94; lead review b388c0c item 5). Same row format
and rules as DECISIONS.md: a bar never changes after its numbers exist; a change needs a new row and the user's OK.

Standing protocol (D88, user 2026-10-13: "stick to the competition setting"): the start-kit split = the Codabench warm-up,
train P01 P02 P03 P06 P07 P10, val P05 P08, **test P04 + P09 (the leaderboard)**; leaderboard metrics (cell-BA ranks;
pooled BA, accuracy beside); last epoch; causal output-prior correction (α 1, n0 3) on every arm; ≥ 6 seeds. Default bar
= D88 (2): test Δ ≥ +0.01 AND val Δ ≥ 0. Per-participant Δ (P04 6 cells / P05 / P08 / P09) and the 4-participant mean are
reported beside every verdict (descriptive; the lead's participant-level rule is a proposal awaiting the user).

| — | ~~T2-X1: pre-normalisation amplitude side input~~ (an idea carried over from the in-house FM project; zero-compute check 2026-10-23 15:11): of the four members only **MOR** normalises per window (`--fm2-align wz` = per-window per-channel std, `--fm2-calib zwin` = per-window z). FBCNet sees `none` = one global constant scale; ShallowNet sees `ea` = causal per-stream whitening; ST-L sees `sz` = causal per-stream channel power + `gain` = a constant ×1.12. All three keep the window's amplitude, relative to its stream. So X1 = per-channel log-RMS + mu / beta log-powers of the raw window, zero-initialised into MOR's head (and the template). **Conditional:** if the user adopts w5320 (MOR dropped, D206 / D207), X1 closes; if MOR stays, pre-register and run it (package shape, bar d141 + new ≥ 0) | T2-X1 | 1.6 used | — | — | **closed 10-23: NOT ADOPTED** (package mix +0.0015, 7 / 12; MOR alone +0.0096: diluted at weight 0.1) |

| T2-D228 | 2026-10-24 | **PARTIAL FINE-TUNING OF THE PER-USER COPIES UNDER vp2-180 + vr** (T2's own refill). T2-D226: softer copies trade seen (−0.008) for new (+0.006); T2-D227: averaging the copy's trajectory is null.
